name: flush_pending_entries_to_targets
description: Walks a fixed table of 32 twenty-byte records and, for each non-zero entry, copies its value into a field of the object it points to, clears the entry and decrements a global count. It returns the last value copied.

name: step_countdown_position_motion
description: Decrements a countdown byte in the object and adds a per-step increment, looked up from a table by the current countdown value, to its position word. When the countdown reaches zero or the step value matches a marker, the byte is set to a sentinel; a negative flag byte instead clears the state if the object is not the active one.

name: dispatch_and_store_object_params
description: Checks a status word's activity bit and a global, then calls a handler chosen from a 32-entry jump table by the low five bits of the status word. Afterwards it copies up to nine parameter words from the object into a slot in a table indexed by a computed offset, and returns the status word.

name: dispatch_and_store_object_params
description: Matches the same status-word dispatch as its sibling routine: it calls a handler selected by the low five bits of the status word, then copies parameter words from the object into an indexed table and returns the status word.

name: clear_and_toggle_status_bits
description: Clears the top bit of a status byte in the object and then flips its lowest bit. It has no other effects and returns nothing.

name: init_object_record_at_cursor
description: When the cursor pointer lies below the frame address, it fills the record at the cursor with coordinates derived from the global value, using clamped offset tests for two axes, and then advances the cursor by one record. Otherwise it calls a fallback routine.

name: append_clamped_object_record
description: Writes a new object record at the global cursor when the cursor is below the frame address, computing clamped horizontal and vertical offsets and setting a state word and a sprite-style flag. The cursor then advances by one record; otherwise it calls a fallback routine.

name: call_routine_if_cleared
description: Returns zero, and calls an unnamed routine first only when a global word is zero.

name: service_pending_interrupt_bits
description: Repeatedly tests four bits of a global pending mask in order, clearing each one as it goes, and calls a handler for a bit when the matching interrupt request bit is set in the custom chip registers. It loops until none of the four bits remain set.

name: update_timed_position_or_expire
description: Decrements a counter in the object, and while the object's direction flag is negative it writes an absolute position into a list entry, computed from the object's base value and a stored offset. When the counter runs out it copies stored fields across, and otherwise it writes a fixed sentinel value into the entry.

name: latch_clamped_scroll_values
description: Calls three unnamed routines, then writes a clamped difference between two stored values into a buffer entry. When a trigger word is non-zero it resets the trigger and stores a table value, choosing between two state values by the sign of a field.

name: latch_object_scroll_values
description: Writes a value from the object into a buffer entry, computes a clamped difference between two object fields, and stores it in a second entry. When a trigger field is set it resets the trigger and stores a pair of parameters, choosing a state value by the sign of another field.

name: tick_countdown_then_invoke_routine
description: Calls three unnamed routines, then, if a stored word is non-zero, decrements a counter byte and calls an unnamed routine once that counter reaches zero. It returns the stored value.

name: tick_object_countdown_handler
description: When an object's pointer field is non-zero, decrements a countdown byte at a fixed offset and calls a handler when the countdown reaches zero, provided a linked value is set. Otherwise it returns the value already held.

name: step_two_stage_ramp_value
description: Advances a two-stage ramp in the object: the first stage steps the current value toward a limit read from a table, the second stage steps it toward a floor and then holds a level, and stage counters are updated along the way. A zero stage flag resets the sequence.

name: advance_three_record_command_streams
description: Iterates over three fixed-size records, each with an active command pointer, reading the next byte-coded command from its stream. The escape value sets a parameter from the following byte, while any other byte selects a note-like index that reinitialises the record's timing and state, and per-step counters are decremented and unnamed routines called as they expire.

name: parse_command_stream_for_record
description: Reads bytes from a record's command stream: the escape value sets a parameter from the next byte and continues, while any other byte initialises the record's state from table entries and resets its counters. It loops over the remaining records and clears a global when finished.

name: parse_command_stream_for_record
description: Parses the same kind of byte-coded command stream for a record. The escape value sets a parameter, and any other byte initialises the record's state from table entries and resets its timing, then the parser continues with the next record in the table.

name: resume_command_stream_for_record
description: Starts parsing a record's byte-coded command stream from the stream pointer saved in the record. Each non-escape byte initialises the record's state from table entries and resets its timing, and the escape value sets a parameter from the following byte.

name: resume_scaled_command_stream
description: Stores a stream byte multiplied by a scale word into the record's timing field, then parses the record's command stream in the same way as its siblings.

name: set_divisor_and_parse_stream
description: Computes a timing value by dividing the constant 750 by a stream byte, stores it in a record word, and then parses the record's command stream.

name: sum_prefixed_bytes_and_parse
description: Reads a count byte and sums that many following bytes, scales the total by a stored factor into the record's timing field, then parses the record's command stream.

name: load_table_block_and_parse
description: Copies a fixed block of fifteen words, selected by a stream byte, from a table into the record, clears its accumulators and flags, then parses the command stream.

name: parse_command_stream_from_cursor
description: Parses a record's byte-coded command stream starting at a cursor passed in as an argument. The escape value sets a parameter from the next byte, and other bytes initialise the record's state from table entries.

name: load_table_entry_and_parse
description: Copies a fourteen-byte table entry selected by a stream byte into the record's fields and then parses the record's command stream.

name: start_stream_from_table_pointer
description: Looks up a stream start pointer from a table by a stream byte and then parses the command stream from that position into the record.

name: copy_word_field_triples
description: Copies two word fields to two other offsets in a structure, moving the base pointer two bytes per pass, and repeats this for three passes.

name: copy_word_field_pairs
description: Copies two word fields to two other offsets in a structure, moving the base pointer two bytes per pass, and repeats this for two passes.

name: analyse_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler gave no pseudo-code for this twelve-instruction routine, so its behaviour cannot be determined from the evidence. The only facts are that it is referenced by address and that it has no recorded calls or registers.

description: As the boot block entry point, it fills in I/O request structures with command codes, offsets and lengths, submits them through the exec library's I/O call, enables DMA through the custom chip, and then returns.

name: call_routine_when_cleared
description: Returns zero, and calls an unnamed routine with a fixed flag value first only when a global word is zero.

name: start_blitter_copy_with_masks
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, then sets its control, masking and modulo registers for a copy operation and writes its size register to start it. It derives the control values from a global word first.

name: blit_shifted_tile_strip
description: Computes a shifted address from a global value and waits for the blitter to finish before each of several blit operations, writing control and size registers for a strip of tiles.

name: blit_masked_tile_strip
description: Computes a shifted address and waits for the blitter between blit operations that use separate first and last word masks and a second source channel, writing the strip's control and size registers.

name: copy_backward_block_with_fixups
description: Copies bytes and longwords backwards from decreasing addresses into a destination buffer, adjusting a character pointer as it goes.

name: emit_text_characters
description: Reads characters from a string: a carriage-return code advances the output position and loops back, a zero byte ends the routine, and other characters are passed to unnamed routines for output.

name: advance_text_past_spaces
description: Handles space characters in a text stream by advancing the text pointer and shifting an accumulator value, then calls an unnamed routine for the next character.

name: load_text_byte_into_state
description: Loads the next byte of a text stream into a global state word and advances the text pointer, then continues the character loop.

name: accumulate_text_byte_value
description: Adds the next byte of a text stream to a global state word and advances the text pointer, then continues the character loop.

name: accumulate_text_byte_into_state
description: Adds the next byte of a text stream to a global state word and advances the text pointer, then continues the character loop.

name: find_first_set_bit_offsets
description: Scans two six-word tables for the first word with bit zero set and the first with bit one set, then derives shift counts from their positions and builds a shift value in a global word for the blitter.

name: blit_rows_with_pointer_steps
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, then repeatedly sets its source and destination pointers, starts a blit of the given size and advances the pointers by a row step, for a count taken from the input.

name: configure_blitter_copy_defaults
description: Writes fixed mask, modulo and control values into the blitter register variables for a copy operation, without starting a blit.

name: start_single_channel_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, writes the mask, control and modulo values for a single-source operation, sets the destination pointer and size from its inputs, and starts the blit.

name: start_blitter_copy_from_pointers
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, writes the mask, control and modulo values for a copy, sets source and destination pointers from its inputs and starts the blit with a size argument.

name: blit_four_bitplane_offsets
description: Waits for the blitter, then for a non-zero input issues four blits with the same control value, each to a destination offset separated by a fixed plane stride from a base computed from the input.

name: set_blit_fixed_state
description: Stores fixed values into global words and returns. The blitter register references listed in the facts do not appear in the pseudo-code, so only these assignments are described.

name: forward_call_then_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine routine and then returns; the global assignment it makes is a self-copy with no effect.

name: write_stepped_longs_to_record
description: Calls several unnamed routines, then writes four long values into a table, each one stride apart from a base read from an object, with a fixed offset added when a flag is set, and stores a second pair of values in the record.

name: pick_background_colour_from_flags
description: Chooses a colour value from four flag tests and writes it to the background colour register, then calls unnamed routines to finish the update.

name: compute_scroll_offsets_from_position
description: Subtracts reference values from two position words, derives a sub-pixel nibble and a coarse offset from each difference, and stores them in fields of the object.

name: iterate_rows_calling_routine
description: Loops over a grid of rows, calling an unnamed routine fourteen times per row and advancing counters, then calls a final unnamed routine before returning.

name: lookup_nibble_table_value
description: Takes the high nibble of a value, scales it, looks up a word from a fixed table and doubles the result into a global word.

name: compute_bitmap_offset_from_position
description: Computes a bitmap offset from a position word by taking its aligned row part, multiplying it by a stride of 38, adding a base value from the object and a fixed displacement, then aligning the result.

name: store_position_with_offset
description: Adds a fixed offset of 608 to a global value when it is non-zero, stores the result in the object, and then calls three unnamed routines.

name: store_negative_offset_position
description: Subtracts a fixed offset of 608 from a global value when it is non-zero, stores the result in the object, and then calls unnamed routines.

name: store_doubled_value_and_loop
description: Stores double a global value into the object, calls an unnamed routine, and then calls a second unnamed routine fifteen times in a loop.

name: store_offset_value_and_loop
description: Stores a global value plus 36 plus itself into the object, calls an unnamed routine, and then calls a second unnamed routine fifteen times in a loop.

name: compute_blitter_row_modulo
description: Computes aligned row and column values from an input and fixed constants, after calling unnamed routines, and writes the results to the blitter's modulo registers.

name: initialise_static_state_table
description: Writes a fixed set of constant values and table addresses into a block of global memory words, including a pointer to a global counter.

name: write_copper_list_pointers
description: Computes a base address from an object and writes long values stepping by a stride, then updates the high word of the second copper list location register.

name: swap_double_buffer_pointers
description: Alternates a global between two buffer address pairs, writing the matching pair of values each time it is called.

name: dispatch_by_index_table
description: Jumps through a table of routine addresses, selected by a global index, treating the jump as a call.

name: call_table_entry_by_index
description: Calls one routine from a table of routine addresses selected by a global index, then returns.

name: start_shifted_blit_with_masks
description: Computes blitter shift and control values from two inputs and, when a global is non-zero, sets masks, pointers and modulos and starts a blit of the computed size.

name: start_shifted_blit_control
description: Builds a blitter control word from a shift value and fixed bits, waits for the blitter, then writes the control and pointer registers for a blit.

name: dispatch_after_two_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then jumps through a table of routine addresses selected by a global index, treating the jump as a call.

name: dispatch_via_index_after_calls
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then jumps through a table of routine addresses selected by a global index, treating the jump as a call.

name: expand_packed_tile_into_buffer
description: Expands a tile from packed source bytes into a destination buffer, writing each source word to two rows of the buffer for a sixteen-row tile.

name: call_routine_for_each_index
description: Runs a flag-dependent setup, then calls an unnamed routine for each index from four down to zero, and returns the value from the last call.

name: release_entries_matching_key
description: Scans a list of twenty-six-byte entries and, for each active entry whose key equals a global index, calls an unnamed routine and marks the entry inactive.

name: process_matching_list_entries
description: Scans the same entry list with several range and status checks, calling an unnamed routine for entries that qualify and clearing their active words.

name: update_entry_positions_from_table
description: For active entries, sets a position word to a global offset plus a value from a table indexed by a field, and calls unnamed routines to finish each update.

name: find_free_list_slot
description: Searches up to 32 ten-byte entries for one whose word at a fixed offset is zero, and calls an unnamed routine when none is free.

name: set_state_find_free_slot
description: Writes fixed values into global words and then searches a ten-byte entry list for a free slot, calling an unnamed routine with the result.

name: copy_record_fields_after_wait
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, copies word fields from a source record into the object, and derives position values from them.

name: reset_entry_table_slots
description: Sets a table base global, calls four unnamed routines, and then clears three global words.

name: clear_active_flags_in_table
description: Walks thirty-two twenty-six-byte entries from a table base and sets each entry's active word to zero.

name: clear_marker_byte_if_match
description: When a global byte equals a fixed character code, clears it and complements the result; otherwise it does nothing.

name: load_colour_longs_from_table
description: Copies a block of long values from a table into global memory words, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: spin_forever_trap
description: Loops forever without doing any work, so the routine never returns; it appears to be a trap rather than a real routine.

name: wait_until_flag_set
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine until a global flag becomes non-zero, then clears the flag and returns.

name: init_audio_channel_registers
description: The facts list the four audio channel location and length registers and the DMA control register. The pseudo-code assigns pointer and length values to matching variables and sets a channel-enable value to one.

name: read_vertical_beam_position
description: Reads two raw custom-chip position bytes, recombines them into a position value and masks the result to nine bits.

name: disable_interrupts_init_copper
description: Writes a value that clears all interrupt enable bits, sets up copper list pointers and then calls six unnamed routines to initialise the system state.

name: toggle_cia_bit_around_call
description: Sets bit six of a global control value, calls an unnamed routine, clears the same bit and stores the value eight in a global word.

name: handle_interrupt_request_bits
description: Tests bits of a pending interrupt mask in a fixed order, clearing or adjusting the mask and calling unnamed routines for the bits that are set.

name: decode_keyboard_serial_byte
description: When a state bit is set, shifts and inverts a keyboard serial byte and calls unnamed routines for its handling, as the listed keyboard serial register indicates.

name: service_interrupt_request_flags
description: Tests bits of a global flag word and calls unnamed routines for the set bits, then updates the flag word.

name: mask_interrupt_enable_bits
description: When a global word is zero, masks it against a fixed bit set and returns; otherwise it continues into a loop over the enable bits.

name: mask_interrupt_request_high_bits
description: Masks a global word against a fixed set of high bits and returns.

name: return_without_effect
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: read_joystick_port_state
description: Reads the joystick movement register and the fire-button bit of the CIA port register, derives a direction and button state from bit tests, and calls two unnamed routines.

name: match_input_against_string_table
description: Compares an input byte with entries of a string table, advancing through the table until a terminator, and calls unnamed routines when a match is found.

name: toggle_state_on_letter_d
description: When a state word is set and the input byte equals a fixed letter code, inverts a global flag, clears two counters and updates the display control register.

name: count_down_ten_thousand_steps
description: Counts down from 10000 in a loop, writing a masked word on each pass, and then calls an unnamed routine.

name: count_down_masked_steps
description: Counts down from 10000 in a loop, writing a different masked word on each pass, and then calls an unnamed routine.

name: count_down_nibble_mask_steps
description: Counts down from 10000 in a loop, writing a nibble-masked word on each pass, and then returns.

name: count_down_colour_mask_loop
description: Counts down from 10000 in a loop, writing a low-nibble masked value on each pass, and then returns. The background colour register is listed among the facts.

name: advance_shift_feedback_register
description: Doubles a global word and adds one when a pair of bit tests indicates feedback, advancing a shift-register style pseudo-random state.

name: advance_scrambled_counter_state
description: Steps a small counter up to five and then scrambles a global state word by multiplying it and reducing the result modulo a fixed value.

name: format_decimal_digits
description: Converts a 32-bit value to decimal digit characters by repeated subtraction of descending powers of ten, writing each digit into a buffer.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only a bad-instruction marker and no meaningful code, so it is decoded data rather than a routine with behaviour.

name: set_playfield_control_registers
description: Clears the playfield scroll register, writes a playfield priority value and a DMA control word, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: init_position_record_fields
description: Stores a computed value and a constant into record fields, derives an adjusted offset from a register input, and then loops over five steps writing entries.

name: move_table_block_clear_source
description: Copies a block of words from one table to another while zeroing the source words, then copies a second, longer block to further tables.

name: clear_word_block_set_value
description: Clears a block of words starting from a fixed table, then sets a global value to thirty.

name: fill_tables_from_generator
description: Fills a 32-entry table and two 256-entry tables with values returned by an unnamed routine, storing one or two values per entry.

name: scale_level_to_colour_nibble
description: Scales a level value and an offset to a capped level of forty-seven, divides it by three and replicates the result across the nibbles, masking with a fixed value.

name: fill_colour_palette_table
description: Fills palette table words by calling an unnamed routine per entry, writing each value to one table or to two tables depending on a flag bit.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: process_nonzero_bytes_in_buffer
description: Walks a byte buffer starting at an index, and for each non-zero byte calls an unnamed routine and advances the index.

name: find_first_nonzero_record
description: Checks four table records spaced thirty-seven longs apart and returns the input value as soon as one has a non-zero first word.

name: advance_four_frame_counters
description: When a global flag is non-zero, increments four counter words; when the first counter passes sixty-three it resets all four, sets a status bit and clears the flag.

name: step_marker_stream_pointer
description: When a global is zero, reads the next pointer-stream byte; a negative marker sets a global to minus one, while other values advance the stream pointer when a counter matches.

name: init_sentinel_output_buffer
description: Writes a sentinel byte at an output pointer, stores the pointer advanced by one, zeroes a counter word, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: write_cia_a_port_bytes
description: Updates the control bits of a global flag word and writes two bytes from its argument to the CIA-A port registers.

name: write_cia_b_port_bytes
description: Updates a control bit of a global word and writes one value and a fixed value to the CIA-B port registers.

name: call_routine_over_word_range
description: Calls an unnamed routine repeatedly over a range of word values stepping by two, starting from the first field of a structure, and increments a global counter on each call.

name: build_sprite_entry_and_blit
description: Waits for the blitter, sets its control values, computes position and attribute words from object fields, writes them into paired display-list slots and starts a blit of the object's data.

name: refresh_record_when_pointer_changes
description: Compares a global pointer with a field of an object's record and, when it has changed, stores the new value and calls an unnamed routine with the record.

name: copy_byte_groups_strided
description: Copies ten groups of four bytes from a source into a destination buffer at fixed strides.

name: start_blit_at_pointers
description: Waits for the blitter, then writes source and destination pointers and a size word and starts the blit in a loop.

name: wait_for_global_zero
description: Sets a global word to zero and then busy-waits until it reads zero, after calling a series of unnamed routines.

name: update_state_flag_branch
description: Returns if a global is non-zero; otherwise it tests the sign of the value and calls unnamed routines, setting a status value of 255 in one branch.

name: clear_large_buffer_block
description: Zeroes a block of several thousand words starting from a fixed table address, then calls an unnamed routine and updates a global according to its sign.

name: set_four_longs_minus_one
description: Sets four global long words to all ones and returns.

name: start_blit_after_routine_calls
description: Calls unnamed routines, waits for the blitter, writes its mask, control and modulo values and a size, then waits again.

name: compute_aligned_position_from_flags
description: Derives a position value from flag bits, aligns it to a sixteen-unit boundary, adds a fixed inset and stores several globals as zero.

name: clear_global_block_words
description: Sets a long run of global variables to zero in sequence, with no calls.

name: reset_flags_when_active
description: When two flag words are set, it writes three global values and then checks a second pair of flags in the same way.

name: process_state_machine_step
description: Runs a long sequence of conditional state updates, calling unnamed routines for timing and table work and writing a status value when an unnamed routine result is non-zero.

name: advance_clamped_state_counter
description: Increments a state counter when it is active, masks its bits and clamps the result into a small range, applying a set of threshold tests.

name: step_state_toward_target
description: Decrements a state word by two while it is non-zero and steps it toward a target value, clearing related globals when the target is reached.

name: update_masked_state_bits
description: When a state word is non-zero, adds four to it, forces some bits with a mask and applies range tests that write a fixed value when they pass.

name: update_masked_state_bits_alt
description: Follows the same state-word update pattern as its sibling routine, testing ranges after masking the state word.

name: reset_or_saturate_state_word
description: Sets a state word to zero when a flag is clear, otherwise sets it to 255 under a sign test, and calls an unnamed routine in either case.

name: bias_and_clamp_high_word
description: Adds a fixed bias of 40960 to a global value, takes the high word, caps it at fifteen and writes the result with a sign-dependent adjustment.

name: dispatch_state_by_mask_bits
description: Tests bit fields of a state word and calls unnamed routines for the matching pattern, then writes a default value of six when a second input is zero.

name: clamp_masked_difference
description: Takes the difference between two masked values, and when it is small enough, clamps it to the nearest allowed step before storing it.

name: step_mode_state_sequence
description: Calls unnamed routines, returns early when a state is non-zero, and otherwise walks a mode sequence, clearing a state word and comparing limits.

name: bias_then_clamp_offset_wide
description: Adds a fixed bias of 5462 to a global value, takes the high word and limits its magnitude to fourteen, unless it has a special value.

name: bias_then_clamp_offset_narrow
description: Adds a fixed bias of 3280 to a global value, takes the high word and limits its magnitude to fifteen before negating it.

name: run_routine_sequence_updates
description: Calls a fixed sequence of unnamed routines and copies global values between them.

name: step_value_by_difference_loop
description: Computes the difference between two global values and repeatedly calls an unnamed routine while the difference is non-zero, stepping the value toward the target.

name: restore_saved_global_pair
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then restores two global words from the values passed in.

name: restore_saved_pair_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then restores two global words from the values passed in, as its sibling routine does.

name: clamp_signed_difference_step
description: Subtracts a stored value from a global, and when the result is negative and within a small window, adjusts it by a doubled stored value.

name: clamp_sum_step_toward_two
description: Adds a stored value to a global, and when the high word is in range, subtracts twice the stored value and sets the state to two.

name: clamp_negative_difference_to_four
description: Subtracts a stored value from a global, and when the high word is in a negative range, sets the result to four.

name: clamp_sum_to_eight
description: Adds a stored value to a global and, when the high word is below nine, sets the result to eight.

name: select_level_by_zero_flags
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then chooses one of two level constants according to whether two global flags are zero.

name: select_level_mask_high_word
description: Chooses one of two level constants from flag tests and masks the high word of a global value.

name: reduce_value_by_capped_step
description: Reduces a signed global by a step capped at fifteen and, when the result is non-zero, applies a bit-test adjustment.

name: add_capped_signed_step
description: Adds a signed step clamped into the range minus fifteen to fifteen onto a global value and returns.

name: select_range_value_from_flags
description: Selects a value from a range according to global flags and a comparison against a fixed constant.

name: adjust_value_by_distance_limit
description: Compares a global value with a limit and, when the difference is outside a small band, adjusts the value by a fixed step.

name: return_if_within_band
description: Returns without effect when a global value is non-zero, or when a difference lies within a small band.

name: scan_table_for_match
description: Steps a global value and calls an unnamed routine, then scans thirty-two table entries for a match against the value.

name: increment_counter_at_offset
description: Clears and sets global values, calls an unnamed routine, then increments a byte counter at a fixed offset.

name: compare_distance_and_adjust
description: Compares two global values, and when their distance is below a limit, derives a shift from the low bits and applies it.

name: clamp_position_within_range
description: Computes the distance between two position words and, when it is within a limit, clamps the position to the nearer bound.

name: accumulate_indexed_bytes
description: Accumulates bytes looked up through a global index into a running total, decrementing the count each step, and calls an unnamed routine.

name: update_limited_counter
description: Calls an unnamed routine, resets two globals and compares a counter against a limit of one hundred twenty-four, applying a range-dependent update when it is exceeded.

name: select_state_by_threshold
description: Tests a state value against a threshold and a set of exact values, then sets flag bits and calls unnamed routines for the matching case.

name: select_state_by_threshold_alt
description: Follows the same threshold and exact-value tests as its sibling routine, setting flag bits for the matching case.

name: set_default_constants_by_flag
description: Chooses between two constant values according to a global flag and writes a default value when the flag is clear.

name: set_constants_when_not_seven
description: Sets a flag value to 255 when a global is non-zero, and assigns the constant seven and a fixed value when the state is not seven.

name: pick_constant_from_flag
description: Assigns one of two constant values depending on whether a flag is zero, then clears a global.

name: set_constant_and_clear
description: Assigns a fixed constant to a global word, clears another global and returns.

name: add_offset_when_not_four
description: Adds a fixed offset of 500000 to a global value when a comparison passes and the result is not four, then sets a state value.

name: select_state_table_entry
description: Handles a state value by testing several flags, selecting a table pointer or writing one of several values, and calling unnamed routines on each branch.

name: decrement_wrapped_counter
description: Decrements a global counter and wraps it to a small range when it goes negative, then reads a value from a pointer.

name: lookup_indexed_table_word
description: Computes a table index from two inputs shifted right by four, looks up a word and tests its top bits before storing the result.

name: walk_linked_index_table
description: Walks an index table, following entries whose mask bits are clear, and stores the first matching entry in a global word.

name: clear_high_flag_in_range
description: When a global value is non-zero and an input lies in range, clears its high flag bit and returns.

name: adjust_value_by_halving_steps
description: Adjusts a global value by halving steps from an input, applying the step only when its sign and magnitude test passes.

name: add_input_to_global
description: Adds an input word to a global value and returns.

name: subtract_halved_input
description: Subtracts either a halved or a full input word from a global value, depending on a comparison of the two.

name: subtract_input_from_global
description: Subtracts an input word from a global value and returns.

name: return_without_effect
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: return_without_effect
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: return_without_effect
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: compute_inverted_bit_mask
description: Returns the bitwise inverse of an input word masked to two bits of a fixed pattern.

name: negate_global_when_bits_set
description: Calls unnamed routines, and when the status bits of an input match, sets a global to minus three minus its previous value.

name: invert_global_when_bits_set
description: Calls unnamed routines, and when the status bits of an input match, sets a global to three minus its previous value.

name: test_composite_status_bits
description: Tests several bit combinations of a status word against fixed masks and returns a flag indicating which pattern matched.

name: check_input_pattern
description: Compares an input word against a fixed pattern under a mask and returns zero on mismatch, otherwise a value derived from the input.

name: dispatch_unrecovered_jump_table
description: Calls unnamed routines and then jumps through a table whose extent could not be recovered by the decompiler, so the destinations are not known.

name: multiply_byte_field
description: Returns a byte field from the input structure multiplied by sixty-four.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only a bad-instruction marker after clearing two globals, so it is decoded data rather than a routine with behaviour.

name: step_mirrored_offset_loop
description: Repeatedly mirrors an offset around a fixed centre value, calling an unnamed routine on each step, and toggles a bit between steps.

name: process_object_list_entries
description: Walks a list of object entries, copying fields between them and updating status bits according to a flag byte and a sign test.

name: select_colour_by_state_flags
description: Chooses a colour value from state flags and sign tests and writes it to the background colour register, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: update_object_position_from_fields
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then updates the object's position words from another object's offset and size fields unless a status bit is set.

name: count_flagged_table_entries
description: Walks a table from a fixed start, counting each entry whose top bit is set and rewriting its word with an input value.

name: count_flagged_table_entries
description: Walks a table from a fixed start, counting each entry whose top bit is set and rewriting its word with an input value, as its sibling routine does.
